item.description:
ゲーム情報

あらすじ

As soon as the she woke up in the first village, the demon king appeared!

The hero and her party were assailed and devoured by monsters…

It wasn’t long before she had become the whore of Luida’s Bar.

“I was a sage who got soiled at LVL1… how about it mister… I’m a bad girl who needs to be punished.”
